title: [react-instantsearch-nextjs@1.1.2] `Cannot find module 'next/headers'` at runtime on Vercel/Lambda after upgrade from 1.0.7
explanation: The issue describes a bug with the `react-instantsearch-nextjs` library after an upgrade, where it fails to work on a serverless (Vercel/Lambda) deployment due to a missing module. This indicates a technical issue that is frustrating and confusing for the user.
